data.description: Hittu, also called the Pink Hen, is a bird-faced play tower with its wings spread as two Sea Green slides. Children climb up a rope net and the pink climbing frame behind the grey bird face, then slide down either wing. Two slides mean two children can come down together, which helps at busy times in a school break. It is designed for ages 5 to 12, takes up to 15 children, and covers 20'3" x 15'4", with a safe play area of 25'9" x 20'4". Play here builds imagination and gross motor skills. It is part of our Organic Play range. The 3-year warranty covers its pipe, moulded parts, laminates and rope. Ask us how Hittu fits your play area.

items.pText: Hittu, also called the Pink Hen, is a bird-faced play tower with its wings spread as two Sea Green slides. Children climb up a rope net and the pink climbing frame behind the grey bird face, then slide down either wing. Two slides mean two children can come down together, which helps at busy times in a school break. It is designed for ages 5 to 12, takes up to 15 children, and covers 20'3" x 15'4", with a safe play area of 25'9" x 20'4". Play here builds imagination and gross motor skills. It is part of our Organic Play range. The 3-year warranty covers its pipe, moulded parts, laminates and rope. Ask us how Hittu fits your play area.

props.imgAlt: Top-view line drawing of Hittu play tower with two slides

props.pText: Hittu is built on galvanised pipe with roto-moulded slides and a play rope net, set self-standing or grouted as the ground needs. The two slides exit on opposite sides, so the 25'9" x 20'4" zone needs clear ground and impact flooring at both ends. Check the net and the bird face panel fixings regularly.

items5.pText: 3 years warranty for Galvanized pipe, Roto molded parts, Composite laminates and Play rope.
1 years warranty for Springs, Bearings and Spare parts.

items6.liText: Ensure the proposed area is clear of any rocks, debris, or other obstructions.
Check that the site is correctly leveled.
Provide proper drainage to avoid accumulation of water.
Make accurate markings as per the foundation drawings provided.
Ensure the depth of PCC is as per the given standard depth.
Ensure proper material handling equipment is available on site.
Provide lifts in case the installation is on terraces or podiums.
Read the installation drawings provided to familiarize yourself with the installation methods.
